description: This Java source file defines the DismissListener class, a WearableListenerService for handling notification dismissals on Android Wear OS devices. It manages data changes related to notification deletions, dismisses wearable notifications by deleting DataItems via GoogleApiClient, and implements connection callbacks and result handling for data deletion operations.

classes.name: DismissListener
classes.description: A WearableListenerService subclass that handles notification dismiss events on Android Wear OS devices, manages connection to GoogleApiClient, and deletes DataItems to remove notifications from the wearable.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes GoogleApiClient with Wearable API and sets up connection callbacks.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles data change events, specifically deleting notifications based on DataEvent type and path.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Receives intents, checks for dismissal actions, and initiates wearable notification dismissal.

methods.name: dismissWearableNotification
methods.description: Connects the GoogleApiClient to trigger data deletion on the wearable device.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Creates a URI for the DataItem and deletes it via DataApi when the GoogleApiClient connects.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Handles suspension of the GoogleApiClient connection (no operation here).

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Logs an error if the connection to GoogleApiClient fails.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the DataApi delete operation, logging failure if needed and disconnecting the client.
